name: tiny-shared-workspace
description: A tiny shared workspace for humans and agents (mocked, no API key)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --target es2022 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext --types node space.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && tsx space.ts > .actual-output.txt && diff -u expected-output.txt .actual-output.txt && echo 'output matches expected-output.txt'
